title: (develop, as #738 on main) The Find prefetch ranking suite keeps passing after its fixture date is a month old: the prefetch clock and the source fetchedAt follow the real clock Postgres now() compares them with
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm all four tests report ok, on any calendar date.
expect: 'changed Find cache reprioritizes unadmitted places while preserving an existing job and snapshot' claims the first admitted job (claimPlaceJob does not return null).
'Find auto batches use 20 site and 10 social admissions' polls only the queued, non-deferred social page on the second tick.
fence: the suite's fixture times are relative to the real clock, never a fixed calendar date
